MapLibre GL JS 5.15.0, copied unchanged from the published package's
`dist/maplibre-gl.js`, `dist/maplibre-gl.css`, and `LICENSE.txt`:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/maplibre-gl/v/5.15.0

These assets are served locally so cached maps do not depend on a CDN.
Keep `maplibre-LICENSE.txt` with the distributed assets. No external
imagery, terrain, or vector datasets are bundled here.

Also bundled unchanged: Lucide 0.468.0 (lucide.min.js, lucide-LICENSE)
and GSAP 3.12.7 (gsap.min.js, upstream gsap-README.md). Their existing
copyright and license links are preserved in the distributed files.
